actions.description: Registers the order-notification queue with Amazon and subscribes it to order changes. Safe to run again.
actions.needsQueue: Save an SQS queue URL first.
actions.title: Order notifications

toast.notAccepted: Amazon did not accept the registration.
toast.registered: Amazon now reports order changes to the queue.

currency.description: Each offer is listed on the connection's marketplaces that sell in this currency.
currency.label: Offer currency

bulk.noMarketplace: This connection has no marketplace OpenLinker knows, so no offer can be listed. Choose its marketplaces on the connection page.

credentials.awsHint: Leave both AWS keys empty to keep the ones already stored.
credentials.awsPaired: Enter both AWS keys, or neither.
credentials.label: Credentials
credentials.missing: No credentials are stored. Re-authorize to use this connection.
credentials.stored: Stored encrypted. Re-authorize when Amazon reports the connection needs it, or after you rotate the app secret.

toast.description: The connection uses the new credentials from now on.
toast.title: Credentials saved

account.description: Set when the connection was created. A different environment needs a new connection.
account.label: Selling Partner API environment

catalogueMarketplace.description: OpenLinker reads the catalogue from one marketplace: the listing content, the price with tax and its currency, the country of the tax rate, and the stock.
catalogueMarketplace.label: Catalogue marketplace

fba.description: Stock Amazon keeps in its warehouses (FBA) is read into this location. It is never written from OpenLinker.
fba.label: FBA stock location
fba.needsFbmLocation: Also turn on "Assign a location to this connection's stock" with a different location, or the FBA stock cannot be kept apart.
fba.needsFbmLocationHere: Also choose the location of the stock you ship yourself, different from the FBA location, or FBA stock cannot be kept apart.
fba.sellsOnOtherChannels: FBA stock counts toward what other channels may sell. Until Amazon ships those orders for you, keep it at a location you do not sell from.

fbm.description: Where the stock you ship yourself is kept. FBA stock is read into a different location, so the two are never added up.
fbm.label: Location of the stock you ship (FBM)

marketplaces.addedNote: Orders from a marketplace you add are read from the start of its history.
marketplaces.description: Orders are read and offers written on these marketplaces.
marketplaces.descriptionSingle: Set when the connection was created. This region has a separate seller account per country, so another marketplace needs a new connection.
marketplaces.label: Marketplaces

mcf.description: How fast Amazon ships the orders OpenLinker hands to Multi-Channel Fulfillment. Faster shipping costs more.
mcf.label: Multi-Channel Fulfillment shipping speed

edit.queueUrlDescription: Amazon delivers order changes to this queue. Register it below after saving.

refunds.description: A refund confirmed in OpenLinker is sent to Amazon for seller-fulfilled orders. When off, OpenLinker only records that you refunded in Seller Central.
refunds.label: Send refunds to Amazon

region.description: Set when the connection was created. Another region is another Amazon account and needs a new connection.
region.label: Region

edit.sellerIdMissing: Without the merchant token, offers cannot be read or written.

taxCodes.description: Amazon gives a listing a product tax code (for example A_GEN_STANDARD), not a rate. Set the rate of each code your account uses: OpenLinker reads a product's VAT rate from it and sends the code with every offer it publishes.
taxCodes.empty: No tax codes have a rate yet, so the VAT rate of Amazon products is not known.
taxCodes.invalid: Each row needs a tax code and a rate such as 23, 8, 0 or zw.
taxCodes.label: VAT rates of Amazon tax codes

plugin.setupCardDescription: Sell on Amazon: import orders, link and publish listings, keep stock and prices in sync.

accountNotice.farEast: In Japan, Australia and Singapore each country is a separate account, so a Far East connection covers one marketplace.
accountNotice.oneRegion: North America, and the EU with the UK, each have one account for all their marketplaces, so choose every marketplace you sell on there.
accountNotice.regionFixed: The region cannot be changed later; for another region, create another connection with that region's credentials.
accountNotice.title: One connection is one Amazon seller account in one region

setup.created: The connection is saved. Run the connection test to check the credentials with Amazon.
setup.description: Connect a Seller Central account through the Selling Partner API.

errors.awsKeysPaired: Enter both AWS keys, or neither.
errors.capabilityRequired: Choose at least one of orders or offers.
errors.marketplaceOtherRegion: A marketplace is served by another region. Choose marketplaces of the selected region only.
errors.marketplaceSingle: Choose one marketplace: in this region each country is a separate account. Create another connection for the next one.
errors.queueUrlInvalid: Enter an SQS queue URL, such as https://sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/amazon-notifications.
errors.sellerIdInvalid: Enter the merchant token from Seller Central: 8 to 20 capital letters and digits.
errors.sellerIdRequired: The merchant token is required to manage offers.

setup.marketplacesHint: Orders are read and offers written on the marketplaces you choose.
setup.marketplacesHintSingle: Each country in this region is a separate seller account, so choose one marketplace.
setup.marketplacesNone: OpenLinker does not list marketplaces for this region yet.
setup.notificationsHint: With an SQS queue, Amazon reports order changes within a minute instead of at the next poll. You can add it later.
setup.offersHint: Link existing listings, publish new ones, and keep stock and prices up to date.
setup.offersMasterHint: A catalogue master's stock is not written back to its own listings, so offers stay off.
setup.ordersHint: Import Amazon orders and send tracking numbers back.
setup.readOnly: Your account can view connections but not create them. Ask an administrator to connect Amazon.
setup.refreshTokenHint: Issued when you authorize the app in Seller Central. It is stored encrypted.
setup.regionHint: The Selling Partner API region that serves your marketplaces.
setup.roleMasterHint: Products and stock from your Amazon listings, sold on your other channels.
setup.roleSalesChannelHint: Products come from your catalogue; Amazon receives offers and sends orders.
setup.sandboxNotice: The sandbox answers with Amazon's sample data only. No real orders or listings are read or changed.
setup.sellerIdHint: Seller Central: Settings, Account info, Merchant token.
setup.sellerIdHintRequired: Required for offers. Seller Central: Settings, Account info, Merchant token.
setup.testUnavailable: The connection test could not run
setup.title: Connect Amazon
